meta.Status: Root cause identified; manual correction prepared, not yet applied in production

sections.heading: Executive Summary
paragraphs: Pool 81410 (Pick'em 10, MLB FANTASY_OU) settled OFFICIAL at 00:42 UTC on 12 July with 3 of 10 legs wrong — all settled UNDER when they should have been OVER. This caused incorrect pool results and 67 tickets with payout discrepancies (net +£177.53 to players on correction).

bold_paragraphs.label: Root cause
bold_paragraphs.text: Fantasy OU approval gate. When a player's stat crossed the over/under threshold (+ 10% settlement buffer), cbstatsfeed created fantasy_approvals instead of publishing FOU_UPD. Three approvals were never actioned by ops before OFFICIAL.

bold_paragraphs.label: Not the cause
bold_paragraphs.text: SportsData lag (cross-checked against MLB Gameday/ESPN play-by-play), manual_override, or settle_manually flags.

sections.heading: Remediation — Pending
numbered: Approve/action or bypass stale fantasy approvals for legs 1, 3, 6
Update market_results and sport_event_histories with correct metric amounts
Pool restart / settlement correction on 81410 and commingled 1659
Apply corrected offer files and process payout adjustments (67 tickets)

sections.heading: Lessons Learned
numbered: Fantasy approval is a single point of failure for FANTASY_OU settlement.
Low OU lines (0.5 K) trigger approval on first event — tote may never update.
stats_feed correctness does not imply tote correctness.
Cross-check public play-by-play before escalating SportsData.
